Laser cutter use is limited to the land/environment models at the beginning of the semester and the model s submitted at the end of the semester by Architectural Design Project 3-4-5-6-7 students. Architectural Design Project 8 students can use the laser cutter during interim juries and submissions at the end of the semester. Cuttings will take place on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Wednesdays. In cuttings as groups, the duration of use is limited to 2 hours, whereas in single cuttings, it is limited to 1 hour.
